Package com.miniandmore.app.client

Class ZohoBooksClient

java.lang.Object
com.miniandmore.app.client.ZohoBooksClient

    • uploadItemImages

      public void uploadItemImages(String itemId, List<ZohoBooksClient.ImageUpload> images)
      Pushes every gallery photo onto the item's photo set via POST /items/{id}/images (plural) rather than the single-photo /items/{id}/image endpoint. Not part of Zoho's published Books v3 reference — confirmed only via community reports of the same books/v3 host. Confirmed live against a real UAT org: each call adds exactly ONE document (its attachment_order increments per call) — sending multiple files in one multipart request silently keeps only the last part, so images must be posted one at a time. A failure is propagated so the product cannot be reported as fully synced with a partial gallery.

    • deleteItemImages

      public void deleteItemImages(String itemId)
      Clears any photos already on the item (single-endpoint front image, plus any documents added via the plural endpoint) before re-adding the current gallery — otherwise repeated syncs would keep appending duplicate copies of the same photos forever. Zoho requires document ids on the plural delete endpoint, so resolve them before clearing the front image whenever the response exposes documents; older Books responses retain the post-delete fallback.

      public Map<String,Object> findSalesOrderByReferenceNumber(String referenceNumber)
      Find a sales order MiniMS already created for this store order number. Used so a second payment-confirm/retry does not open another Confirmed SO after the first was invoiced/closed.

    • updateSalesOrderBillingAddress

      public Map<String,Object> updateSalesOrderBillingAddress(String salesOrderId, Map<String,Object> address)
      Zoho rejects inline billing_address/shipping_address on create when the serialized object exceeds 100 characters. Apply one-off addresses after SO creation instead.

    • listPackagesForSalesOrder

      public List<Map<String,Object>> listPackagesForSalesOrder(String salesOrderId, String salesOrderNumber)
      Packages shown from a Books sales order are exposed by Zoho's Inventory API. Search by the human-readable sales-order number to keep the response bounded, then verify the immutable id so similarly numbered orders cannot advance the wrong store order.
